title: Skillshot Gym
description: A warm-up trainer for MOBA players. Four 40-second drills: Reaction (flash on enemies, ignore bait), Skillshot (lead a juking target with Q), Last Hit (time your attack's wind-up to secure CS) and Dodge (right-click to move, Flash out of skillshots, AoE circles and hooks). Run the 3-minute Warm-Up before you queue, track your personal bests and trend, and climb the leaderboards.
